entry.name: ArcticFlavor
entry.value: scarred by cosmic forces and ancient debris. This expansive terrain features a mosaic of dust, rocks, and craters, revealing the moon's tumultuous history. It holds the secrets of cosmic events and perhaps ancient civilizations, attracting explorers in search of rare resources and hidden mysteries. The regolith, shaped by relentless impacts, stands as a silent witness to the cosmic drama of the 41st millennium.

entry.name: DesertFlavor
entry.value: a desolate, toxic landscape, scarred by the remnants of industry and warfare. Barren stretches of ashen ground and corrosive streams define this inhospitable terrain. Skeletal remains of industrial complexes and war machinery stand as haunting reminders of unchecked technological progress. Amidst the ruins, mutated creatures thrive, posing a threat to scavengers seeking resources in this apocalyptic expanse. The Sulphor Wastes symbolize the consequences of relentless conflict and industrialization in unforgiving reality.

entry.name: GrasslandFlavor
entry.value: Imperial Hulk debris, remnants of once-majestic Imperial Navy warships, now scattered across desolate star systems. Twisted metal, shattered spires, and broken gun turrets tell a story of grandeur turned devastation. Forged by the Adeptus Mechanicus, these colossal structures now form hazardous fields in space. Salvagers and scavengers navigate these treacherous zones, seeking relics and lost technology among the dangers of void-dwelling xenos and opportunistic pirates. Scholars speculate on the origin of each Imperial Hulk, while the debris fields serve as a constant reminder of the ceaseless conflicts engulfing the Warhammer 40,000 galaxy.

entry.name: OceanFlavor
entry.value: Who knows what treasures have been swept into Gladius' mighty seas? What long-lost artefacts lie crusted with coral amidst its deep-ocean smokers and light-fearing sea aberrations? Given the richness of the land, no-one has ever explored these questions.

entry.name: RiverFlavor
entry.value: This freshwater watercourse wends its way to the sea, concentrating the wealth of mountains and fields as it does. Infantry regiments are less interested in the river's bounty and more in its capabilities as a natural defensive line.

entry.name: RocksFlavor
entry.value: Thrust up by the planet's seismic hell, these freshly-revealed crags might be bare of organic life, but are a superb source of the rare minerals at Gladius' heart.

entry.name: SavannaFlavor
entry.value: Mixed woodland and grassland proliferates here, atop the inevitable human and xenos ruins, making for a landscape that's both fertile and home to the planet's unique ore-rich 'trees'.

entry.name: TundraFlavor
entry.value: a mystical landscape adorned with ancient symbols, resonating with unseen cosmic forces. This enigmatic terrain, free from the scars of industry and war, exudes an otherworldly aura. Despite its serene appearance, the plains are home to ethereal creatures drawn to the mystic energies. Scholars and seekers of arcane knowledge are lured by the symbols that hint at untold cosmic truths. In the vast tapestry of the 41st millennium, the Glyph Plains stand as a surreal anomaly, a haven untouched by the ceaseless conflicts of the galaxy.

entry.name: VolcanicFlavor
entry.value: ancient relics from a forgotten era, composed of an indestructible material adorned with mysterious patterns. These hexagonal plates interlock to form a modular battlefield, influencing the course of battles and holding tactical significance. Legends suggest they are remnants of advanced civilizations pre-dating the Imperium of Man, and their true purpose remains shrouded in mystery. In the midst of war, HexaTiles become focal points, coveted for their strategic importance and rumored latent energies. These enigmatic constructs stand as silent witnesses to the passage of time, awaiting discovery or exploitation on the battlefield.
